chunks.body: evaluates resolution outcome, optionally triggers issue_credit_note, unfreezes payment and stamps resolution audit entry
chunks.docstring: Close an open invoice dispute by accepting, partially crediting, or rejecting the buyer claim.

chunks.body: reads net terms and approval state, picks pay date honoring early-discount window, enqueues payment run entry
chunks.docstring: Schedule an approved invoice for payment on its optimal due date given terms and cash policy.

chunks.body: batches due payments, converts amounts via convert_settlement_currency, submits to payment rail, marks entries in-flight
chunks.docstring: Execute a scheduled payment run, releasing funds to suppliers through the configured rails.

chunks.body: parses remittance lines, matches to scheduled_payment and invoices, clears settled items and flags unmatched residue
chunks.docstring: Reconcile an inbound remittance advice against open scheduled payments and invoices.

chunks.body: checks pay date against discount window, computes sliding discount rate, reduces settlement amount and records savings
chunks.docstring: Apply an early-payment (dynamic discount) deduction when settling before the discount cutoff.

chunks.body: fetches FX rate for value date, applies conversion with rounding rule, captures rate and spread for audit
chunks.docstring: Convert a payable amount from invoice currency to settlement currency at the booking rate.

chunks.body: joins payment run entry to rail acknowledgements, maps rail codes to canonical status, returns status with timestamps
chunks.docstring: Fetch the current lifecycle status of a payment from scheduled through cleared or returned.

chunks.body: validates payment is reversible, books offsetting entry, reopens linked invoice and notifies reconcile_remittance
chunks.docstring: Reverse a settled payment that was returned, duplicated, or sent in error.

chunks.body: aggregates scheduled_payment by pay date, nets early-discount savings, projects daily outflow over horizon
chunks.docstring: Forecast near-term cash outflow from scheduled and pending payment runs.

chunks.body: ingests carrier and supplier signals, compares lead times against baseline, raises disruption event above threshold
chunks.docstring: Detect an emerging supply disruption from inbound signal feeds and lead-time anomalies.

chunks.body: traces affected POs and lanes from detect_supply_disruption, estimates at-risk units and stockout dates
chunks.docstring: Assess the downstream impact of a detected disruption on orders, inventory, and service levels.

chunks.body: selects ranked alternate from approved list, checks capacity and qualification, reallocates open lines and notifies procurement
chunks.docstring: Fail over open demand to a qualified alternate supplier when the primary is disrupted.

chunks.body: weights region indicators, blends supplier concentration and lane fragility, returns normalized region risk score
chunks.docstring: Score baseline supply risk for a sourcing region from geopolitical, logistics, and concentration factors.

chunks.body: polls weather and labor-action feeds, geomatches events to active lanes, emits signals consumed by detect_supply_disruption
chunks.docstring: Monitor weather systems and port-strike feeds for events threatening active lanes.

chunks.body: ranks options from assess_disruption_impact, sequences failover and expedite actions, assigns owners and target dates
chunks.docstring: Build a prioritized mitigation plan for an assessed disruption with actions and owners.

chunks.body: reloads score_region_risk inputs, injects realized event severity, decays toward baseline over recovery window
chunks.docstring: Recompute a region risk score after a confirmed disruption event to reflect realized exposure.

chunks.body: selects expedite mode and lane, recomputes ETA, books premium freight and updates mitigation plan progress
chunks.docstring: Expedite a critical inbound shipment via premium freight to compress recovered lead time.

chunks.body: pulls latest published lists, diffs against cached entries, upserts additions and delistings with effective dates
chunks.docstring: Synchronize the local sanctions and watchlist tables from upstream regulator publications.

chunks.body: normalizes party identifiers, fuzzy-matches against synced lists, records hits and confidence for escalation
chunks.docstring: Rescreen a trading party against the current sanctions lists after a list sync or party change.

chunks.body: resolves involved countries and HS codes, evaluates embargo rules, returns block or pass with cited rule
chunks.docstring: Check whether a shipment's parties, goods, and route fall under an active country embargo.

chunks.body: matches transaction attributes to exception criteria, validates conditions and expiry, returns eligibility with rationale
chunks.docstring: Evaluate whether a license exception applies to an otherwise restricted transaction.

chunks.body: packages rescreen_party hit context, assigns to compliance queue by severity, holds transaction pending decision
chunks.docstring: Escalate a confirmed or ambiguous sanctions screening hit to compliance for adjudication.

chunks.body: serializes action, actor, matched rule, and outcome, appends to append-only audit store with hash chain
chunks.docstring: Append an immutable audit-log entry for every sanctions screening and adjudication action.

chunks.body: enumerates active parties touched by sync_sanctions_list diff, invokes rescreen_party per party, batches escalations
chunks.docstring: Bulk-rescreen all active parties whose exposure may have changed following a sanctions list sync.

chunks.body: records adjudication outcome, adds scoped whitelist entry, writes write_sanctions_audit_log closure entry
chunks.docstring: Clear a screening hit adjudged a false positive and whitelist the match for future runs.

chunks.body: collects OTIF, inventory turns, and freight panels, arranges layout, caches rendered dashboard snapshot
chunks.docstring: Assemble the executive supply-chain KPI dashboard from component metric panels.

chunks.body: joins promised vs actual delivery and fill, counts orders meeting both on-time and in-full, returns OTIF ratio
chunks.docstring: Compute on-time-in-full attainment over delivered orders for the reporting window.

chunks.body: reloads compute_otif inputs, drops orders flagged force majeure, recomputes attainment on remaining base
chunks.docstring: Recompute OTIF with force-majeure-flagged orders excluded from the denominator.

chunks.body: aggregates period COGS, averages opening and closing inventory, returns annualized turns ratio
chunks.docstring: Compute inventory turnover from cost of goods sold and average inventory value.

chunks.body: aggregates per-supplier delivery, defect, and price metrics, weights dimensions, ranks suppliers into tiers
chunks.docstring: Build a supplier scorecard blending quality, on-time, and cost-variance dimensions.

chunks.body: aggregates settled freight charges, groups by lane mode and carrier, computes spend and cost-per-unit rollup
chunks.docstring: Roll up freight spend across lanes, modes, and carriers for the reporting period.

chunks.body: serializes cached build_kpi_dashboard panels, renders export format, writes versioned snapshot artifact
chunks.docstring: Export a point-in-time dashboard snapshot to a shareable artifact for distribution.

chunks.body: reloads build_supplier_scorecard metrics, recomputes dimension scores, updates panel while preserving tier thresholds
chunks.docstring: Refresh an existing supplier scorecard with the latest period data without rebuilding tiers.
